codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '27-27-1-digital-quantum-simulation'
circuit = QuantumCircuit(2)
circuit.h([0,1])
steps = 3
dt = 0.2
for _ in range(steps):
    circuit.rzz(2*dt, 0, 1)
    circuit.rx(2*dt, 0)
    circuit.rx(2*dt, 1)
sv = Statevector.from_instruction(circuit)
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'time': steps*dt, 'statevector': [complex(x).__repr__() for x in sv.data]}))

codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '27-27-3-hamiltonian-simulation'
from qiskit.quantum_info import SparsePauliOp
H = SparsePauliOp.from_list([('ZI', 0.5), ('IZ', -0.3), ('XX', 0.2)])
circuit = QuantumCircuit(2)
circuit.ry(0.7,0)
circuit.ry(1.1,1)
from qiskit.primitives import StatevectorEstimator
est = StatevectorEstimator().run([(circuit, H)])
value = float(est.result()[0].data.evs[0])
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'expectation': value}))
